verses.text: For the one directing. A Psalm of David. Hear, O God, my voice in my complaint; from the dread of the enemy, may You preserve my life.

segments.text: For the one directing. A Psalm of David. Hear, O God, my voice in my complaint; from the dread of the enemy, may You preserve my life.

verses.text: Hide me from the counsel of the wicked, from the mob of workers of iniquity,

segments.text: Hide me from the counsel of the wicked, from the mob of workers of iniquity,

verses.text: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim a bitter word [as] their arrow,

segments.text: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim a bitter word [as] their arrow,

verses.text: to shoot in secret [at] the blameless; suddenly they shoot at him, and do not fear.

segments.text: to shoot in secret [at] the blameless; suddenly they shoot at him, and do not fear.

verses.text: They strengthen themselves [in] a word of evil; they recount the hiding of snares—they say, “Who is looking at them?”

segments.text: They strengthen themselves [in] a word of evil; they recount the hiding of snares—they say, “Who is looking at them?”

verses.text: They search out injustice: “We have perfected a searching plot.” And the inner man and the heart [is] deep!

segments.text: They search out injustice: “We have perfected a searching plot.” And the inner man and the heart [is] deep!

verses.text: And God will shoot at them an arrow—suddenly they will be wounded.

segments.text: And God will shoot at them an arrow—suddenly they will be wounded.

verses.text: They will be made to stumble, their own tongue [being] against them; all those looking on them will flee.

segments.text: They will be made to stumble, their own tongue [being] against them; all those looking on them will flee.

verses.text: And all mankind will fear, and they will declare the work of God, and His deed they will wisely consider.

segments.text: And all mankind will fear, and they will declare the work of God, and His deed they will wisely consider.

verses.text: A righteous one will be glad in YHWH, and he will take refuge in Him; and let all the upright in heart exult!

segments.text: A righteous one will be glad in YHWH, and he will take refuge in Him; and let all the upright in heart exult!
